title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
difficulty: Medium
position: 11
complexity: O(n log n)
=== statement
Pick some numbers from the array, keeping their order, so that each picked number is strictly larger than the one before. What is the most numbers you can pick?
=== input
The first line has `n`. The second line has the `n` integers.
=== output
Print the length of the longest increasing subsequence.
=== constraints
1 <= n <= 131072
1 <= values <= 10^6
=== sample
8
10 9 2 5 3 7 101 18
--- expected
4
=== sample
4
7 7 7 7
--- expected
1
=== test
1
5
--- expected

=== test
5
1 2 3 4 5
--- expected

5
5 4 3 2 1
--- expected

=== test

2 2 2 2 2 2
--- expected

=== test
